policy.purpose: Normalize evidence-backed same-person identities, correct synthetic discovery labels, and split disputed composites before stable person-ID freeze.
policy.raw_provenance: Segment source strings remain unchanged. Synthetic raw labels are preserved in identity_resolution.source_raw_labels but need not become searchable aliases.
policy.disputed_identity: When evidence does not justify a merge, create separate REVIEW candidates and preserve an explicit possible-same-person relation.
policy.core_gate: CORE candidates must not retain unresolved composite canonical labels. REVIEW-only disputes may remain explicit without blocking CORE distillation.

之侯/初无余/莽安.basis: Shiji Suoyin / Bamboo Annals tradition explicitly connects 王之侯, 初无余之 and 莽安 as the same ruler.

代王嘉赵嘉.basis: 赵嘉 was established as 代王 after the fall of Handan; title and personal name refer to one person.

卫疌伯/挚伯.basis: The received Wei ruler sequence records 卫疌伯; Shiben transmits the same ruler as 卫挚伯.

卫考伯/孝伯.basis: The transmitted title variant is recorded as 卫考伯, also called 卫孝伯.

卫贞伯/箕伯.basis: The received Wei ruler sequence records 卫贞伯; Shiben transmits the same ruler as 卫箕伯.

帝喾高辛氏.basis: Structural normalization of a legendary ruler label: title/name and traditional clan-style designation are stored separately.

帝挚高辛氏.basis: Structural normalization only. 高辛氏 is not emitted as an identity hint because that designation is also attached to 帝喾 and would create a false cross-person collision.

晋哀公/懿公/敬公.basis: Different transmitted sources use 哀公, 懿公 and 敬公 for the same ruler 骄.

晋孝公/桓公.basis: The ancient Bamboo Annals tradition calls 晋孝公 晋桓公.

晋静公/靖公.basis: 静/靖 is a transmitted title variant for the final Jin ruler 俱酒.

曲沃武公/晋武公.basis: 曲沃武公 was later recognized as 晋侯 and is the same person conventionally called 晋武公.

楚王比熊比.basis: CTP identifies 楚王比 and 熊比 as the same person.

楚王负刍熊负刍.basis: CTP identifies 楚王负刍 and 熊负刍 as the same person.

王保保/扩廓帖木儿.basis: 王保保 and 扩廓帖木儿 are names used for the same Yuan/Northern Yuan figure.

王延羲/王曦.basis: 王延羲 changed his name to 王曦 after accession.

王延钧/王鏻.basis: 王延钧 used 王鏻 after accession; the records describe one person.

王继鹏/王昶.basis: 王继鹏 later changed his name to 王昶.

翁/朱句.basis: The Yue ruler is transmitted as 王翁 and also as 朱句/州句.

鲁真公/慎公.basis: Transmitted sources preserve 真公/慎公 as posthumous-title variants for the same Lu ruler; Shiji uses 真公 while Hanshu Lülü zhi uses 慎公.

鼫与/鹿郢/与夷.basis: The same Yue ruler is transmitted under 鼫/鼫与, 鹿郢 and 与夷/适郢 variants.

夫谭/无谭.basis: 夫谭 is directly transmitted as the predecessor/father of 允常. The synthetic composite is removed; 无谭 remains a reported variant for later verification and is not promoted to an identity hint.

虞公/虞惠公.basis: The last ruler is directly transmitted as 虞公; a secure primary-source basis for the label 虞惠公 was not established in this pass. Keep the latter as a review note, not a true alias.

许庄公茀/苴人.basis: The ruler identity 许庄公 is secure, while transmitted scholarship differs over the private-name reading 茀/苴人 and even questions whether 苴人 is a style rather than a personal name. Canonicalize the ruler title without forcing the disputed token into identity matching.

韩共侯/懿侯韩若山.basis: Shiji/Suoyin and Bamboo Annals scholarship explicitly connect 韩若山 with 懿侯, while 共侯/庄侯 are transmitted title variants for the same ruler rather than a second CORE person.

虢宣公/虢季子白.basis: The discovery label conflated a debated identification. Scholarship has treated 虢季子白 as 虢宣公 in some reconstructions and as a distinct figure / different generational placement in others. The corpus therefore keeps two REVIEW candidates rather than deciding the controversy by normalization.

王光泰等夔东集团.action: Exclude this aggregate string from the person index; enumerate qualifying individuals separately if evidence supports them.

夫谭_无谭_variant.note: CORE canonical identity is fixed as 夫谭; verify whether 无谭 has an independent textual witness before ever promoting it to an alias.

虞公_虞惠公_variant.note: 虞公 remains REVIEW and is canonicalized only to remove a synthetic slash label; 虞惠公 is not treated as an identity hint.

虢宣公_虢季子白_relation.note: Both are separate REVIEW candidates with an explicit possible-same-person relation; no merge is assumed.

许庄公_private_name.note: 许庄公 is secure; whether 苴人 is a personal name, style, or textual variant remains open and does not affect ruler-level identity.
